test_title: RRB NTPC CBT 2 (Level-3) Official Paper (Held On: 17 June 2022 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
Four people Shweta, Ranu, Ekagra and Tanmay are seated at the four corners of a square table. Two of them are facing the centre while two are facing in the direction opposite to the centre. Ranu is seated to the immediate right of both Tanmay and Shweta. Shweta is sitting to the immediate right of Ekagra. Tanmay is seated to immediate left of Ekagra. Ekagra is not facing the centre.

Who among the four is not facing the centre?
solution:
**Explanation:**

 
• **Number of people = 4** namely, **Shweta, Ranu, Ekagra and Tanmay.**
 
• They are** seated at the four corners of a square table. **
 
• **Two of them are facing the centre** while **two are facing in the direction opposite to the centre.**
 
• Ekagra is not facing the centre.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/66c045da7ff8e334c49f7b4b1ebf40b85b1a947ba0a8a9d2518f996f5fbc9a8f.png] 

 
• Shweta is sitting to the immediate right of Ekagra.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/56f0c3b033a66d5348b0ce14686c67096435612d338201181543160ed287209d.png] 

 
• Tanmay is seated to immediate left of Ekagra.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/b6f013792f25ab1e2914f94c3cdd8e9e07d0a685f4f0f1bcd9b0c9d8fdf1133f.png] ​

 
• Ranu is seated to the immediate right of both Tanmay and Shweta. 
 
• The final arrangement will be represented as:
 
• ** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/a1d0e10d6fe189738449ee9166aebeb32c5e0cd35c3caadc2a5f534a81d4dc11.png] **
 
• **Shweta and Ekagra are not facing the centre.**

Hence, **Shweta and Ekagra** is the **correct answer.**
